definition.scenario: T20 at Indian venues; second innings only; first known pre-delivery state per chase with 2-4 wickets down, 18-42 legal balls already bowled, required rate 12-20 RPO, and runs needed > 0.
definition.anchor: The first delivery in each chase meeting every condition; measurements start on that delivery.
definition.measurement_window: Anchor delivery through the innings, stopping before the first unknown-legality row. Unknown-legality rows and subsequent state-unknown deliveries are excluded.
definition.batter_runs_and_balls: Runs use the raw runs field; faced balls are known deliveries that are not wides. Byes and leg-byes are counted as one team run for target/state reconstruction, as in the confirmed source-data rule.
definition.boundary_and_dot_metrics: Boundary events are fours plus sixes; boundaries per 100 balls and dot percentage use batter balls faced as the denominator.
definition.stayed_to_over_16: Numerator: player was not dismissed before the 96th known legal ball. Denominator: player was at the crease before legal ball 96 and the known segment reached at least 96 legal balls. Innings without that opportunity are excluded.
definition.dismissals: is_wicket rows excluding retire-outs, retire-hurt rows, and obstruction labels.
definition.target: revised_target when present; otherwise first-innings raw total plus one, counting one run for each wide, no-ball, bye, or leg-bye event.
definition.rank_order: The displayed supplied list order is a user reference, not recalculated from raw data. The supplied table does not define a clutch-specific ranking formula.
definition.composite_formula: Raw-data rank: 50% adjusted strike-rate percentile + 30% adjusted-average percentile + 20% boundary-share percentile; adjusted SR uses a 60-ball cohort-baseline prior; adjusted average uses a 3-dismissal cohort-baseline prior. Raw figures remain displayed. Players need 30 balls, 2026 all-venue T20 activity, and at least 10 known chase innings; cohort needs 20 decided chases and 10 eligible players.
definition.unweighted_diagnostics: Dot percentage and survival through over 16 are shown as diagnostics but are not part of the confirmed composite score.
definition.manual_exclusions: Rashid Khan (ID 4722), Dhruv Jurel (ID 7260), and Shashank Singh (ID 2756) are retained in the raw figures and excluded only from the final ranking at the user's request.
definition.previous_selection_gates: The previously confirmed 30-ball minimum, a 2026 T20 appearance at any venue, and at least 10 known second-innings chase appearances are shown separately as eligibility flags; they do not change raw figures displayed here.
